title: Subcontracted tests
purpose: Follow external handoffs and source acceptance for individual requested tests. Start a handoff from the received sample’s requested-test row.

items.label: Search
items.description: Case-insensitive contains over external laboratory, external reference, dispatch sample ID, laboratory sample ID and client name. It does not search the later source-only sample ID, analyte or entered result.

items.label: State
items.description: All subcontracts includes cancelled records. Awaiting source result means active with no source versions; Awaiting source review means latest active source lacks a decision. Accepted source and Rejected source use only the latest source decision. Cancelled dispatch shows cancelled records.

items.label: Subcontract
items.description: Generated EXT number links to handoff/source history. No New button is provided; send work out from its sample.

items.label: Source status
items.description: Cancelled dispatch, Awaiting source result, Awaiting source review, Accepted source or Rejected source; not sortable.

items.label: Lab ID
items.description: Links to sample receipt; client appears below.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: Requested analyte; the dispatch belongs to one requested test, not the whole sample.

items.label: External laboratory / External reference
items.description: Recorded actual arrangement and order/dispatch reference.

items.label: Handed over
items.description: Completed handoff timestamp. Default sort is newest handoff first.

items.label: Find a sample
items.description: Empty-list action opens Samples so an eligible requested test can be selected.

sections.title: Table controls
paragraphs: All laboratory staff can read; portal accounts cannot. Invalid filters show errors/no rows and invalid page size is refused. No-match offers clearing/widening filters; no handoffs offers Find a sample.

items.label: Apply / Clear all / filter chips
items.description: Apply searches/filters all handoffs and starts at page 1. Clear all restores defaults; remove a chip to clear only that criterion.

items.label: Headings / Columns
items.description: Linked headings sort the whole matching set, with record ID breaking ties. Columns changes browser-local visibility/order with reset; subcontract ID stays visible.

items.label: Rows per page / Show / Pagination
items.description: 25 default, with 25/50/100 choices. Show submits if automatic size submission is unavailable. Size changes start at page 1. First/Previous/Next/Last retain criteria; counts reflect all matches.

items.label: Column checkboxes
items.description: Changes apply immediately. Check to show an optional column or uncheck to hide it. Always shown columns are fixed.

items.label: Move column up / down
items.description: Moves an optional column within the displayed order; the first/last position disables the unavailable move. You can also drag movable table headers.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restores this table’s default order and visibility in this browser.

items.label: Done / Close
items.description: Closes the dialog; layout changes have already been applied and saved locally. No laboratory record is changed.
